title: Real-World Experience with Brolucizumab Compared to Aflibercept in Treatment-Naïve and Therapy-Refractory Patients with Diabetic Macular Edema

groups.description: Treatment-naive centre-involving DME, prospective institutional cohort (Charite Berlin, July 2022 to December 2023), 12 eyes of 8 patients: five brolucizumab injections at 6-week intervals (upload), then a modified treat-and-extend protocol from week 36 (at least 8 weeks after the upload). Deferred panretinal laser in four patients after the first injection.

groups.agent: brolucizumab 6 mg intravitreal (switch after bevacizumab, ranibizumab, aflibercept and/or dexamethasone implant)
groups.description: Recalcitrant centre-involving DME persisting despite at least 6 months of anti-VEGF treatment (at least 6 consecutive monthly injections and/or a dexamethasone implant), switched to brolucizumab, 23 eyes of 16 patients: at least two injections every 6 weeks, continued every 6 weeks up to five as needed, then treat-and-extend. The reported period starts at the switch (baseline = first brolucizumab injection). Panretinal laser in two patients during the study.

exclusions.reason: complete-case and post-baseline selection: the retrospective aflibercept cohort included only eyes with a full upload of six 4-weekly injections and a follow-up of at least 36 weeks, equal to the last tabulated visit; the article does not state that no treated eye was left out (protocol inclusion 5; brief complete-case ruling)

complete-case and post-baseline selection: inclusion required at least two consecutive aflibercept injections after the switch and a follow-up of at least 36 weeks after the switch, equal to the last tabulated visit; no statement that no treated eye was left out
aflibercept-only visits (N/A for brolucizumab); the aflibercept columns are excluded
baseline only; the same baseline is cited from Table 2

exclusions.what: Mean BCVA values and letter equivalents of the changes in the Abstract, Results and Discussion text
exclusions.reason: text values; the Table 2 cells are cited, and letter equivalents derived from logMAR changes are not a series with a baseline

exclusions.what: Proportions of eyes with resolved centre-involving DME, fluid status, treatment intervals and injection counts
exclusions.reason: not acuity; proportions and counts are not admissible

notes: Unit: BCVA was assessed in logMAR in the brolucizumab group (Methods 2.1; the aflibercept group was converted from decimal acuity); Table 2 states logMAR with no Snellen or decimal row.

Statistic: Table 2 header labels the values as mean BCVA + SD and its footnote defines SD; the Statistical Analysis section says means +/- SEM are reported. The values are means either way; the dispersion is not extracted.
Role control for both brolucizumab groups: brolucizumab is an approved agent used in routine care and compared with aflibercept from a registry; no investigational arm is declared.
Regimen treat_and_extend: modified treat-and-extend protocol after the upload (treatment-naive) or after at least two 6-weekly injections (switch).

No minimum follow-up criterion is stated for the prospective brolucizumab cohorts and no larger treated cohort is described; the Discussion notes increasing loss to follow-up after the 9-month period, beyond the tabulated visits.
Several patients contributed both eyes (12 eyes of 8 and 23 eyes of 16 patients).
Central retinal thickness (Table 2 CRT columns), fluid status and treatment intervals are reported in the article and mentioned here only.

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 2, row R4, Treatment-Naive DME / Mean BCVA / Brolucizumab column C2)
series.notes: Mean (Table 2 header 'Mean BCVA + SD (logMAR)'); each follow-up cell also prints a p-value after the mean, and the leading mean is read. Rows 'Week 4-6' and 'Week 16-18' combine the two agents' visit schedules; Methods 2.2 state brolucizumab visits at baseline and weeks 6, 12, 18, 24 and 36, so these rows are dated week 6 and week 18 for this column. The week-36 visit is described in Methods as 8-12 weeks after the week-24 injection; the table label (week 36) is used. Weeks converted with weeks x 7 / 30.4375. Per-visit n not reported; the Results give week-36 outcomes for all 12 eyes. Handling of missing visits not stated. Panretinal laser given to four patients after the first injection; values were not removed.

series.baseline_label: Baseline at the switch (Table 2, row R4, Recalcitrant DME / Mean BCVA / Brolucizumab column C6)
series.notes: Mean (Table 2 header 'Mean BCVA + SD (logMAR)'); each follow-up cell also prints a p-value after the mean, and the leading mean is read. Time origin is the switch to brolucizumab. Rows 'Week 4-6' and 'Week 16-18' combine the two agents' visit schedules; Methods 2.2 state brolucizumab visits at baseline and weeks 6, 12, 18, 24 and 36, so these rows are dated week 6 and week 18 for this column. Some eyes were extended to an 8-week interval after two injections (from week 18), so their later visits may not coincide exactly with the tabulated weeks (not stated); the table labels are used. Per-visit n not reported; the Results give week-36 outcomes for all 23 eyes. Handling of missing visits not stated. Panretinal laser in two patients during the study; values were not removed.
